treatment: w<NN> weight arms (the averaged new MF map under blend weight w); w25 = chain CH1 arm new
arms: fixed_arms + one arm w<NN> per blend weight in chain_inputs.json (sorted; 0.25 required)
variants: fixed arms: stored; arm w<NN>: its own variant (MF = averaged new map, mixture weight w)
secondary_contrasts: w<NN>_minus_pcombo for every other weight arm, then w<NN>_minus_w25 for every weight arm except w25
contrasts: w<NN>_minus_pcombo for every weight arm (ascending w), w<NN>_minus_w25 for every other weight arm, then replay_contrasts
query_set: all 707 images (each a query image of its outer fold)

base_lane.derived_from: chain/case (order CH1), itself detect_20261113/mfcomb; order CH2

map_arithmetic: flat ordered float32: w*MF + ((1-w)/2)*full + ((1-w)/2)*local (np.float32 of each weight, insertion order MF, full, local; w = 0.25 is the shipped .25/.375/.375 mixture bit for bit); SHIP_R3 candidates; repair map = the same mixture; MF of an image = integer level sum of its n set maps (uint16, levels <= 510) / (510 n) as one float32 division, no requantisation; n = 1 gives map / 510 bit for bit
keep: saved C5 LR39 models and saved thresholds; query image f in partition s uses model (s, outer_s(f)); training images of fit (s, k) use model (s, k)

v1_recipe.target: best v1-grid tau of the uniform whole-kept-set repair; never-matched excluded
v1_recipe.inner_folds: selector machinery: assign_groups(groups of the outer-training images, 3, seed + 10000 + outer)
v1_recipe.applied_to_variants: the same 100 fitted regressors, not refit

selector.recipe: StandardScaler + LogisticRegression(C=1, max_iter=2000, random_state=42, lbfgs), no class weights, ConvergenceWarning is an error
selector.bank: MF-mixture SHIP_R3 candidates of the outer-training images
selector.cutoff: count_plan.threshold_sweep over inner-held-out probabilities of the outer-training images, pooled per-annotation PQ on the arm's own masks; ties lower

label_rule: one row per (candidate, nonempty annotation set); 1 if IoU > 0.5 with any GT of that set; unrepaired mask (all arms)
pass2: pcand.repair_taus on the kept set (exclusion = other kept candidates), outer v1 taus

gate.note: descriptive only in the chain (the order asks for contrasts, not a verdict): the sibling lanes rule CI95 lower > 0, >= 16/20, all five fold means > 0

inputs.chain_inputs: chain_inputs.json (label, fold tokens, weights, per fold one pinned archive per map set, dataset scope)

blocking: local audit: inc, inc_pnat, inc_pcand_v1 and pcombo counts, keeps, outer v1 taus, v1 fit statistics, pcombo selector states, scores and replay contrasts = pcombo results
frozen evaluator replay of the three incumbent values
pcombo map OOF provenance for all 15 stored maps
uniform-tau repair equals pnat.repair on every kept pattern (stored)
all 78 features finite for every candidate of every variant
duplicate audit on all 707: 0 overlapping prediction pairs and 0 GT matched by more than one prediction, every arm
query isolation: assert_split + train identity for each of the 100 outer v1 fits and 100 x 3 x 4 selector fits
ship: pcombo deployment selector byte-identical to the pinned package selector; pcombo test CSV byte-identical to 35abbeed...
local recomputation of every PQ, delta and interval (< 1e-12)
inputs: every set archive pinned (bytes, md5, sha256), run id per set and fold as in the fold tokens, key set = the base fold, uint16 [2048, 2048], levels <= 510

ship.cutoff: median of the arm's 100 nested cutoffs
ship.fit: presel.fit_selector on all 707 images of the arm's bank, twice, byte-identical
